messages:
priya: Quick q — can we nudge the v1.8 cutoff on Dec 20 by ~6–10h? US holiday + DST overlap is making EU folks miss the window. :calendar:

tom: +1 to nudging, mornings are rough for EU teams this week.

maria: what's the current cutoff timestamp? I have 2026-12-20 16:00 UTC in the calendar.

priya: yeah that's the one. proposal: move it to 2026-12-20 22:00 UTC or 2026-12-21 02:00 UTC. prefer keeping same date if possible.

jamal: 22:00 UTC collides with infra maintenance (we have a scoped upgrade at 23:00 UTC). 02:00 UTC would avoid both EU morning and infra.

alex: are there outstanding blocking PRs that would force us to keep the earlier cutoff?

priya: blockers list: #4523 (changelog formatting), #4550 (version bump), #4518 (docs). all small but need reviews.

maria: i'll ping reviewers on #4550 and #4523 now. tagging @alex for the bump.

alex: on it — opening the bump PR and will start cherry-picks. PR: https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/4567

release-bot: scheduled maintenance alert — infra upgrade planned 2026-12-20 23:00 UTC. See https://status.redwood.ai for details.

priya: ok decision leaning to 2026-12-21 02:00 UTC. who can bridge that slot? need someone until 03:30 UTC.

jamal: I can cover 00:30–03:00 UTC. @maria can you take 03:00–07:00?

maria: yep can do 03:00–07:00. will add to my calendar and the oncall rotation.

tom: do we need to update the shared release calendar event? I can edit it and add notes.

priya: please update and add this note: 'cutoff moved +10h due to holiday/DST; backports required by cutoff; infra maintenance avoided'. include the new cutoff timestamp.

tom: updated the calendar event and description. event link: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=abc123def456

maria: checklist added to event: merge changelog, run changelog script, bump versions, cherry-pick urgent fixes. also added the command snippet:

```
python scripts/generate_changelog.py --since=last_release
```

alex: pushing a version bump commit to release/v1.8.0, will open backport PRs after merge.

jamal: note for oncall: fallback policy — if CI fails repeatedly, postpone to Dec 21 12:00 UTC (next fallback window). see ops playbook in #eng-releases.

priya: sounds good. i'll DM the release bridge 6h before cutoff as a reminder. :bell:

tom: small ask — can we add a changelog nudge in the release checklist to remind authors to sign off on docs? i've seen last-minute churn.

maria: added a checkbox: 'authors confirm changelog entry + docs preview link'.

priya: final: cutoff set to 2026-12-21T02:00:00Z. merging plan: bump -> run tests -> generate changelog -> tag. anyone object?

alex: no objections. i'll prioritize the bump PR review.

jamal: i'll handle bridge notifications and update the rotate list.
